annotations.title: Local circumstances of solar and lunar eclipses

description: Solar and lunar eclipses seen from a place: local type, contact times (C1-C4, P1-P4, U1-U4), magnitude, obscuration, duration of totality and the Sun's or Moon's altitude. E.g. {start: '2026-08-01', end: '2026-08-31', latitude: 39.47, longitude: -0.38}. For eclipse chasers, planetariums, schools and travel apps: solar eclipses from the place's own viewpoint (local type: total, annular, partial or none; contacts C1, C2, maximum, C3, C4 with the Sun's altitude and azimuth; magnitude, obscuration, duration, duration of totality or annularity) and lunar eclipses (penumbral and umbral contacts P1, U1, U2, maximum, U3, U4, P4 with the Moon's altitude, umbral and penumbral magnitude, durations), each marked visible when the body is above the horizon. Matches NASA's predictions to a few seconds (2024-04-08 at Dallas, 2025-03-14 lunar eclipse). Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.10 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/eclipse-local (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

end.description: Last UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after start.

kinds.description: Eclipse kinds to return. Default: both.

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: local_eclipse

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

counts.description: eclipses, and visible: those with the Sun or Moon above the horizon at a contact or at maximum.

eclipses.description: One row per eclipse: kind, global_type, greatest_eclipse_utc, key, visible, and local_type (solar), magnitude, obscuration, umbral/penumbral magnitude (lunar), contacts [{contact, utc, local, timestamp, and the Sun's or Moon's altitude, azimuth, above_horizon}], durations and visible.

settings.description: start, end, kinds and every convention (discs, contacts, magnitude, visibility).

subject.description: The place and its time zone.

title: Local circumstances of solar and lunar eclipses
